text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing, Trainer! I can't believe 
you actually won it!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Even though it's just about my own 
siblings... thank you."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'll be sure to tell my little sisters 
that my Trainer won this for us!
